label: capture-verification-help
stdout:
usage: harnessctl capture-verification [-h] --id RECORD_ID --work-order
                                       WORK_ORDER --verification VERIFICATION
                                       --evidence EVIDENCE [--owner OWNER]
                                       [--output OUTPUT] [--domain DOMAIN]
                                       [--json]
                                       [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id RECORD_ID
  --work-order WORK_ORDER
                        work order to verify; repeat for aggregate candidates
  --verification VERIFICATION
                        applicable verification contract; repeat for aggregate
                        candidates
  --evidence EVIDENCE   retained evidence path; repeat for aggregate
                        candidates
  --owner OWNER         preparation actor and record owner; does not verify
                        the record
  --output OUTPUT
  --domain DOMAIN       place the record in an explicit engineering domain
  --json                emit the canonical workflow result as JSON
